messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I opened a PR that bundles the release notes + changelog entries for the model-catalog changes and the deprecation timeline. Also added a short migration snippet. Need reviewers and a green docs preview before we merge into release-slate.
Sam: Thanks — can you drop the PR link? I can take an initial pass.
Maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4587 — label: 'release/next'. Main items: model A -> model A-quantized deprecation note, migration steps for tokenizer changes, and an updated changelog entry.
Jordan: I'll review API surface and SDK snippets. Quick Q: did you include the deprecation date in both release notes and model catalog page?
Maya: Yep — added 2026-05-15 in both places and a cross-ref from the catalog. But CI is failing for the docs preview right now (link checker).
ci-bot: build started for PR #4587 — docs preview job queued.
Caleb: I saw the failure in the preview earlier — it was an internal link to the tokenizer guide that changed path after the restructuring. I pushed a tiny fix in a separate commit.
Maya: Thanks. The preview URL is up but 404s on one anchor: https://deploy-preview-4587--redwood-docs.netlify.app/model-catalog/#tokenizer-changes
docs-preview-bot: preview build failed: Broken link detected at /model-catalog/: anchor "tokenizer-changes" not found. See job logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/builds/9823
Ash: I can add a redirect anchor on the tokenizer guide page. Do we want to preserve the old anchor or update the changelog to point to the new section id?
Maya: Prefer preserve old anchor (backwards compat) + note in changelog with new canonical link. That keeps release notes stable.
Sam: Reviewing now. Two quick comments in PR:
- Line in release-notes.md: "model A will be sunset" -> suggestion: "model A (v1) will be deprecated; v1 users should migrate to model A-quantized by 2026-05-15."
- SDK snippet: python example uses old param name `model_name`. Should be `model`.
Jordan: For migration snippet, suggest adding this tiny code block so users can update tokenizer usage:
```python
# before
client.generate(model_name="model-a", prompt=prompt)
# after
client.generate(model="model-a-quantized", prompt=prompt, tokenizer="v2-tokenizer")
```
Maya: Added the suggested edits and pushed. Also added a short migration note under "breaking-changes" — one paragraph.
Caleb: Re-ran link checker locally, all green. Requeued docs preview.
ci-bot: build started for PR #4587 — docs preview job queued.
docs-preview-bot: preview published: https://deploy-preview-4587--redwood-docs.netlify.app — please smoke test.
Sam: LGTM on content. Two tiny nits in wording, otherwise good. I'll add `approved` in GitHub once those nits are tweaked.
Maya: Done. Also added checklist to PR description: reviewers (Sam, Jordan), docs preview link, QA steps, and migration checklist.
Jordan: Approved. Sam please finalize — we want this merged before the release branch cut at 18:00 UTC.
Sam: Will merge after CI is green. ETA ~15m.
ci-bot: all checks passed for PR #4587.
Sam: Merged into release-slate and created release notes draft. :tada:
Maya: Thank you everyone. Action items: Caleb to add redirect anchor in main site (small follow-up PR), Ash to monitor support channels for migration questions next week.
Caleb: On it — will open PR with redirect and add a short note in site-ops.
Ash: I'll prepare a short blurb for the community changelog about tokenization differences.
Maya: Closing thread — will follow up in #release-war-room if anything pops.
